svg.title: Уголок на турнике — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Hanging L-sit HOLD from a true high horizontal pull-up bar. Full body in three-quarter side view, both hands grip fixed bar overhead, elbows straight, torso vertical, feet unsupported. Both legs are straight, together and lifted straight forward to waist level, forming a clear 90-degree L shape. Athlete hangs below the bar with hands above head, never on top. Full simple two-post station with floor feet visible, no straps, rings, chair or parallel bars. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
